bio_en: Hakob Vardanian, called Jartar and Murad Khan, was a fighter of Salno Dzor who, though without schooling, stayed with the revolutionary cause into his mid-forties. In 1897 he led 66 haiduks to Khlat and handed over the arms they carried to Aghbyur Serob and Gurgen on Mount Nemrut. In 1898 he crossed the same route again with 66 men, fighting the heroic battle reported in Droshak from the plain of Aintap to Khlat, in which he lost his only brother. Undaunted by Aghbyur's death, he carried on the work until he himself fell; Droshak mourned him in August 1901.
